correctness.rationale: Two independent combinatorial validity predicates in the package cover all 2^12=4,096 arc masks and agree. An independent implementation reproduced 278 nonempty faces, f=(12,54,104,84,24), and mod-two reduced Betti ranks (1,4,4) in degrees (2,3,4). The package verify.py was read: integer signed boundary columns satisfy d²=0 and Schur-complement cancellations use only unit ±1 pivots (counts 11,43,60,20 in degrees 1..4), leaving free zero-differential groups Z,Z4,Z4; this excludes hidden torsion. Every one of 24 vertex symmetries induces an oriented simplicial permutation. The checker calculates their chain-boundary-image traces over p=1009 and recovers the rational homology character; dimensions at most 4 uniquely fix integer traces from residues. Character is (1,q,epsilon*q) for q the action on F2^3/<111>. Its averages yield fixed dimensions (1,1,0). No infinite family or integral lattice representation is claimed.
residual_risks: The integral cancellation and rational representation code was inspected, with independently regenerated face counts and mod-two ranks, but not a full separate integer Smith/character execution; implementation risk remains bounded by explicit unit-pivot steps and exact formulas.
